## Upgrading to 5.13

### Rust library

- `RuntimeInner` has a new public field, `build_trace: Mutex<Option<Arc<BuildTrace>>>`, so a struct literal needs `build_trace: Mutex::new(None)`. A pipeline keeps there how it was built, so that a conversion refused for its size can name the operation that makes it so deep, such as a `from_color` beneath data that ends at level 12.
